pages.text: Macaw's adds proper $(l)roofs$(), $(l)doors$(), $(l)windows$(), walls and bridges. Copycats can take on the look of any block.$(br2)Upgradable chests and barrels (Sophisticated Storage) plug straight into Create's belts and funnels.
Shaders are optional: $(l)Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs$(). Complementary Unbound is moody and foggy; MakeUp Ultra Fast is for gentler machines.
